titles.my: မိုင်ချန် (၁): ကမန်းကတန်း မနက်ခင်း
titles.th: ไมจัง (1): เช้าวันวุ่นวาย

meaning.vi: Đang ~ / ở trạng thái ~ (sống ở đâu, đang làm gì).
meaning.en: Be ~ing / ongoing state (where one lives, what one is doing).
meaning.zh-Hans: 正在……／处于……状态（住在哪里等）。
meaning.zh-Hant: 正在……／處於……狀態（住在哪裡等）。
meaning.my: ~ နေတယ် (အခြေအနေ)။
meaning.th: กำลัง ~ / อยู่ในสภาพ ~

meaning.vi: Xin hãy ~ (nhờ, yêu cầu lịch sự).
meaning.th: กรุณา ~ (ขออย่างสุภาพ)

meaning.vi: Làm ~ cho người khác (mình là người làm giúp).
meaning.en: Do ~ for someone (I do the favor).
meaning.my: တခြားသူအတွက် ~ ပေး။
meaning.th: ทำ ~ ให้คนอื่น

meaning.vi: Không biết ~ nhỉ (tự hỏi mình, thân mật).
meaning.th: ~ ไหมนะ (ถามตัวเอง)

quiz.ja: マイちゃんは、どこに住んでいますか。

explain.vi: Bé từ Việt Nam sang, giờ sống ở Osaka.
explain.en: She came from Vietnam and lives in Osaka.
explain.pt: Veio do Vietnã, mora em Osaka.
explain.my: ဗီယက်နမ်က လာပြီး အိုဆာကာမှာ နေတယ်။
explain.th: มาจากเวียดนาม อยู่ที่โอซาก้า

quiz.ja: 朝、ビンくんはなぜ笑いましたか。
choices: マイちゃんのパーカーが反対だったから
マイちゃんがころんだから
ご飯がおいしかったから

explain.th: ใส่ฮู้ดกลับด้าน

choicesFurigana.surface: マイちゃんのパーカーが
マイちゃんがころんだから

quiz.ja: 宿題をわすれたマイちゃんに、先生は何と言いましたか。
choices: ほんとうのことが言えて、えらい
ゆきちゃんに見せてもらって

explain.vi: Cô khen Mai đã nói thật, và dặn mai mang đến.
explain.en: She praised Mai for telling the truth.
explain.tl: Pinuri siya dahil nagsabi ng totoo.
explain.pt: Elogiou Mai por dizer a verdade.
explain.th: ชมว่าพูดความจริง

jaFurigana.surface: をわすれたマイちゃんに、

quiz.ja: 宿題の紙に、何がありましたか。
choices: ビンくんがかいたマイちゃんの絵

explain.vi: Bin vẽ chị Mai bằng bút sáp lên tờ bài tập.
explain.en: Bin drew Mai in crayon on the sheet.
explain.tl: Iginuhit ni Bin si Mai gamit ang krayola.
explain.pt: Bin desenhou Mai com giz de cera.
explain.my: ဘင်က မမကို ခရေယွန်းနဲ့ ဆွဲထားတယ်။
explain.th: บินวาดรูปพี่ไมด้วยสีเทียน

choicesFurigana.surface: ビンくんがかいたマイちゃんの

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、九さいの女の子です。
sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, kyuusai no onnanoko desu.

translations.vi: Mai-chan là một bé gái 9 tuổi.
translations.en: Mai-chan is a nine-year-old girl.
translations.tl: Si Mai-chan ay siyam na taong gulang na batang babae.
translations.id: Mai-chan adalah anak perempuan berumur sembilan tahun.
translations.pt: Mai-chan é uma menina de nove anos.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန်က ကိုးနှစ်အရွယ် မိန်းကလေးပါ။
translations.th: ไมจังเป็นเด็กผู้หญิงอายุเก้าขวบ

meanings.th: เด็กผู้หญิง

grammarNote.vi: 「〜ちゃん」: gọi thân mật trẻ em. 「AはBです」: A là B. 〜さい = 〜歳 (tuổi).
grammarNote.en: 「〜ちゃん」 = cute suffix for kids. 「AはBです」 = A is B. 〜さい = years old.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 「〜ちゃん」＝对小孩的昵称。「AはBです」＝A是B。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 「〜ちゃん」＝對小孩的暱稱。「AはBです」＝A是B。
grammarNote.my: 「AはBです」 = A က B ပါ။
grammarNote.th: 「AはBです」 = A คือ B

sentences.ja: ベトナムから来て、いまは大阪に住んでいます。
sentences.romaji: Betonamu kara kite, ima wa Oosaka ni sundeimasu.

translations.vi: Bé từ Việt Nam sang, giờ đang sống ở Osaka.
translations.en: She came from Vietnam and now lives in Osaka.
translations.zh-Hans: 她从越南来，现在住在大阪。
translations.zh-Hant: 她從越南來，現在住在大阪。
translations.ko: 베트남에서 와서 지금은 오사카에 살고 있습니다.
translations.tl: Galing siya sa Vietnam at nakatira na ngayon sa Osaka.
translations.ne: उनी भियतनामबाट आएकी हुन्, अहिले ओसाकामा बस्छिन्।
translations.id: Ia datang dari Vietnam dan kini tinggal di Osaka.
translations.pt: Veio do Vietnã e agora mora em Osaka.
translations.my: ဗီယက်နမ်က လာပြီး အခု အိုဆာကာမှာ နေတယ်။
translations.th: เธอมาจากเวียดนาม ตอนนี้อาศัยอยู่ที่โอซาก้า

grammarNote.vi: 「〜から来ました」: đến từ ~. 「〜に住んでいます」: đang sống ở ~.
grammarNote.en: 「〜から来る」 = come from ~. 「〜に住んでいる」 = live in ~.
grammarNote.th: อาศัยอยู่ที่ ~

sentences.ja: 小学校の三年生です。

translations.vi: Bé học lớp 3 tiểu học.
translations.en: She is in third grade at elementary school.
translations.tl: Nasa ikatlong baitang siya sa elementarya.
translations.ne: उनी प्राथमिक विद्यालयको कक्षा ३ मा पढ्छिन्।
translations.pt: Está no terceiro ano do ensino fundamental.
translations.my: မူလတန်း တတိယတန်း ကျောင်းသူပါ။
translations.th: เธอเรียนชั้นประถมปีที่สาม

meanings.my: မူလတန်းကျောင်း
meanings.th: โรงเรียนประถม

grammarNote.vi: 〜年生 = học sinh năm thứ ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜年生 = ~th-grader.
grammarNote.th: 〜年生 = ชั้นปีที่ ~

sentences.ja: 赤いヘアピンと、黄色いパーカーが大好きです。
sentences.romaji: Akai heapin to, kiiroi paakaa ga daisuki desu.

translations.vi: Bé rất thích chiếc kẹp tóc đỏ và áo hoodie vàng.
translations.en: She loves her red hairpin and yellow hoodie.
translations.zh-Hans: 她最喜欢红发卡和黄色连帽衫。
translations.zh-Hant: 她最喜歡紅髮卡和黃色連帽衫。
translations.ko: 빨간 머리핀과 노란 후드티를 아주 좋아합니다.
translations.tl: Mahal na mahal niya ang pulang hairpin at dilaw na hoodie.
translations.ne: उनलाई रातो हेयरपिन र पहेँलो हुडी धेरै मन पर्छ।
translations.id: Ia sangat suka jepit rambut merah dan hoodie kuning.
translations.pt: Ela adora a presilha vermelha e o moletom amarelo.
translations.my: ဆံပင်ညှပ်အနီနဲ့ အဝါရောင် ဟူဒီကို အရမ်းကြိုက်တယ်။
translations.th: เธอชอบกิ๊บสีแดงกับเสื้อฮู้ดสีเหลืองมาก

grammarNote.vi: 「〜が大好きです」: rất thích ~. 「AとB」: A và B.
grammarNote.en: 「〜が大好き」 = love ~. 「AとB」 = A and B.

sentences.ja: 家族は四人です。

translations.vi: Gia đình có bốn người.
translations.en: There are four people in her family.
translations.tl: Apat sila sa pamilya.
translations.th: ครอบครัวมีสี่คน

grammarNote.vi: 四人 = よにん (bốn người).
grammarNote.en: 四人 = yonin (four people).
grammarNote.my: 四人 = လေးယောက်။

sentences.ja: やさしいお母さんと、おもしろいお父さん。

translations.vi: Một người mẹ hiền và một ông bố vui tính.
translations.en: A kind mother and a funny father.
translations.zh-Hans: 温柔的妈妈和有趣的爸爸。
translations.zh-Hant: 溫柔的媽媽和有趣的爸爸。
translations.tl: Isang mabait na nanay at isang nakakatawang tatay.
translations.id: Ibu yang baik hati dan ayah yang lucu.
translations.pt: Uma mãe carinhosa e um pai engraçado.
translations.my: သဘောကောင်းတဲ့ အမေနဲ့ ရယ်စရာကောင်းတဲ့ အဖေ။
translations.th: แม่ใจดีกับพ่อตลกๆ

grammarNote.vi: やさしい = hiền. おもしろい = vui, thú vị. Tính từ -い đứng trước danh từ.
grammarNote.en: やさしい = kind. おもしろい = funny. い-adjective + noun.
grammarNote.my: い-နာမဝိသေသန + နာမ်။
grammarNote.th: คุณศัพท์ い + คำนาม

sentences.ja: それから、五さいの弟のビンくんです。
sentences.romaji: Sorekara, gosai no otouto no Binkun desu.

translations.vi: Và em trai 5 tuổi, bé Bin.
translations.en: And her five-year-old little brother, Bin.
translations.tl: At ang limang taong gulang niyang kapatid, si Bin.
translations.id: Lalu adik laki-lakinya yang lima tahun, Bin.
translations.pt: E o irmãozinho de cinco anos, Bin.
translations.my: ပြီးတော့ ငါးနှစ်အရွယ် မောင်လေး ဘင်။
translations.th: แล้วก็น้องชายอายุห้าขวบ บิน

grammarNote.vi: それから = và rồi, ngoài ra. 「〜くん」: gọi thân mật bé trai.
grammarNote.en: それから = and also. 「〜くん」 = suffix for boys.
grammarNote.th: 「〜くん」 = เรียกเด็กผู้ชาย

sentences.ja: ある朝のことです。

translations.vi: Vào một buổi sáng nọ.
translations.en: One morning.
translations.tl: Isang umaga.
translations.my: မနက်တစ်မနက်မှာ။
translations.th: เช้าวันหนึ่ง

grammarNote.vi: 「ある〜」: một ~ nọ.
grammarNote.en: 「ある〜」 = a certain ~.

sentences.ja: 「マイ、起きて！ もう七時半よ！」

translations.vi: "Mai, dậy đi! Bảy rưỡi rồi đấy!"
translations.en: "Mai, get up! It's already seven thirty!"
translations.tl: "Mai, gising na! Alas-siyete y medya na!"
translations.ne: "माई, उठ! सात बजेर तीस मिनेट भइसक्यो!"
translations.pt: "Mai, acorda! Já são sete e meia!"
translations.th: "ไม ตื่นได้แล้ว! เจ็ดโมงครึ่งแล้วนะ!"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜て！」: nói tắt của 〜てください (thân mật). もう = đã ~ rồi. 〜半 = rưỡi.
grammarNote.en: 「〜て！」 = casual request. もう = already. 〜半 = half past.
grammarNote.th: ขอแบบกันเอง

sentences.ja: 「えっ、七時半？ たいへん！」

translations.vi: "Hả, bảy rưỡi? Chết rồi!"
translations.en: "What, seven thirty? Oh no!"
translations.tl: "Ha, alas-siyete y medya? Naku!"
translations.my: "ဟင်၊ ခုနစ်နာရီခွဲ? ဒုက္ခပဲ!"
translations.th: "เอ๊ะ เจ็ดโมงครึ่ง? แย่แล้ว!"

grammarNote.vi: たいへん = chết rồi, gay go.
grammarNote.en: たいへん = oh no, terrible.

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、ベッドからとび出しました。

furigana.surface: マイちゃんは、ベッドからとび

sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, beddo kara tobide shimashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan bật dậy khỏi giường.
translations.en: Mai-chan leapt out of bed.
translations.tl: Tumalon si Mai-chan mula sa kama.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် ကုတင်ပေါ်က ခုန်ထွက်လိုက်တယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังกระโดดลงจากเตียง

grammarNote.vi: 「〜から」: từ ~. とび出す = lao ra. 「〜ました」: quá khứ lịch sự.
grammarNote.en: 「〜から」 = from ~. とび出す = dash out.

sentences.ja: 顔を洗って、パーカーを着て、ご飯を食べます。
sentences.romaji: Kao o aratte, paakaa o kite, gohan o tabemasu.

translations.vi: Rửa mặt, mặc hoodie, ăn cơm.
translations.en: She washes her face, puts on her hoodie, and eats breakfast.
translations.tl: Naghilamos, nagsuot ng hoodie, at kumain.
translations.ne: मुख धोइन्, हुडी लगाइन्, खाना खाइन्।
translations.id: Cuci muka, pakai hoodie, lalu makan.
translations.pt: Lava o rosto, veste o moletom e come.
translations.my: မျက်နှာသစ်၊ ဟူဒီဝတ်၊ ထမင်းစား။
translations.th: ล้างหน้า ใส่ฮู้ด แล้วกินข้าว

meanings.th: หน้า, ใบหน้า

grammarNote.vi: 「〜て、〜て、〜」: nối các hành động theo thứ tự. 着る = mặc (áo).
grammarNote.en: 「〜て、〜て」 = linking actions in order. 着る = wear.
grammarNote.my: အစဉ်လိုက် လုပ်ဆောင်ချက်။
grammarNote.th: ทำต่อเนื่อง

sentences.ja: 「お姉ちゃん、パーカーが、反対だよ！」

translations.vi: "Chị ơi, áo hoodie mặc ngược rồi kìa!"
translations.en: "Sis, your hoodie's on backwards!"
translations.tl: "Ate, baligtad ang hoodie mo!"
translations.my: "မမ၊ ဟူဒီ ပြောင်းပြန် ဖြစ်နေတယ်!"
translations.th: "พี่ ฮู้ดใส่กลับด้าน!"

grammarNote.vi: お姉ちゃん = chị (gọi thân mật). 「〜だよ」: nói thường, báo cho biết.
grammarNote.en: お姉ちゃん = big sister. 「〜だよ」 = casual "you know".
grammarNote.my: お姉ちゃん = မမ။
grammarNote.th: お姉ちゃん = พี่สาว

sentences.ja: 「あっ、ほんとうだ！」

translations.vi: "Á, đúng thật!"
translations.en: "Oh, you're right!"
translations.tl: "Ay, totoo nga!"
translations.my: "အာ၊ တကယ်ပဲ!"
translations.th: "อ๊ะ จริงด้วย!"

grammarNote.vi: ほんとうだ = đúng thật.
grammarNote.en: ほんとうだ = it's true.

sentences.ja: ビンくんは、ゲラゲラ笑いました。

translations.vi: Bin cười ha hả.
translations.en: Bin roared with laughter.
translations.tl: Humalakhak si Bin.
translations.my: ဘင် တဟားဟား ရယ်တယ်။
translations.th: บินหัวเราะก๊าก

grammarNote.vi: ゲラゲラ = cười ha hả (từ tượng thanh). 笑う = cười.
grammarNote.en: ゲラゲラ = belly laugh (onomatopoeia). 笑う = laugh.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ゲラゲラ＝哈哈大笑（拟声词）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ゲラゲラ＝哈哈大笑（擬聲詞）。
grammarNote.th: เสียงหัวเราะ

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、走って学校へ行きました。
sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, hashitte gakkou e ikimashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan chạy đến trường.
translations.en: Mai-chan ran to school.
translations.tl: Tumakbo si Mai-chan papuntang paaralan.
translations.pt: Mai-chan foi correndo para a escola.
translations.th: ไมจังวิ่งไปโรงเรียน

grammarNote.vi: 「〜て行く」: đi bằng cách ~. 「〜へ」: đến (hướng).
grammarNote.en: 「〜て行く」 = go by ~ing. 「〜へ」 = toward.

sentences.ja: 教室には、友だちのゆきちゃんがいました。

furigana.surface: だちのゆきちゃんがいました。

sentences.romaji: Kyoushitsu ni wa, tomodachi no Yukichan ga imashita.

translations.vi: Trong lớp có bạn Yuki-chan.
translations.en: Her friend Yuki-chan was in the classroom.
translations.tl: Nasa silid-aralan ang kaibigan niyang si Yuki-chan.
translations.pt: Na sala estava a amiga Yuki-chan.
translations.my: စာသင်ခန်းထဲမှာ သူငယ်ချင်း ယူကီချန် ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: ในห้องเรียนมีเพื่อนชื่อยูกิจัง

grammarNote.vi: 「〜には〜がいました」: ở ~ có (người). Dùng いる cho người, động vật.
grammarNote.en: 「〜に〜がいる」 = there is (a person) at ~. いる for living things.
grammarNote.tl: いる para sa may buhay.
grammarNote.my: いる = သက်ရှိ။
grammarNote.th: いる ใช้กับสิ่งมีชีวิต

sentences.ja: 「マイちゃん、おはよう。宿題、やった？」

translations.vi: "Mai-chan, chào buổi sáng. Làm bài tập chưa?"
translations.en: "Morning, Mai-chan. Did you do the homework?"
translations.tl: "Magandang umaga, Mai-chan. Ginawa mo ba ang takdang-aralin?"
translations.my: "မိုင်ချန်၊ မင်္ဂလာနံနက်ပါ။ အိမ်စာ လုပ်ပြီးပြီလား။"
translations.th: "อรุณสวัสดิ์ ไมจัง ทำการบ้านหรือยัง"

grammarNote.vi: おはよう = chào buổi sáng (thân mật). やった？ = thể thường quá khứ của やる (làm).
grammarNote.en: おはよう = good morning (casual). やった？ = did you do?

sentences.ja: 「宿題？ やったよ。……あれ？」

translations.vi: "Bài tập à? Làm rồi chứ. ...Ơ kìa?"
translations.en: "Homework? I did it. ...Huh?"
translations.tl: "Takdang-aralin? Oo naman. ...Ha?"
translations.th: "การบ้าน? ทำแล้วสิ ...อ้าว?"

grammarNote.vi: あれ？ = ơ? (khi thấy lạ).
grammarNote.en: あれ？ = huh? (surprise).

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、かばんの中を見ました。

furigana.surface: マイちゃんは、かばんの

sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, kaban no naka o mimashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan nhìn vào trong cặp.
translations.en: Mai-chan looked inside her bag.
translations.tl: Tiningnan ni Mai-chan ang loob ng bag.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် အိတ်ထဲကို ကြည့်တယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังดูในกระเป๋า

grammarNote.vi: 〜の中 = bên trong ~. 「〜を見る」: nhìn ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜の中 = inside ~.

sentences.ja: ノートも、えんぴつも、あります。

furigana.surface: ノートも、えんぴつも、あります。

translations.vi: Có vở, có bút chì.
translations.en: The notebook is there, and the pencil too.
translations.tl: Nandoon ang kuwaderno at lapis.
translations.ne: कापी पनि छ, पेन्सिल पनि छ।
translations.my: မှတ်စုစာအုပ်လည်း ခဲတံလည်း ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: มีทั้งสมุดและดินสอ

meanings.my: မှတ်စုစာအုပ်

grammarNote.vi: 「AもBも」: cả A lẫn B. ある = có (đồ vật).
grammarNote.en: 「AもBも」 = both A and B. ある = there is (things).
grammarNote.my: A ရော B ရော။
grammarNote.th: ทั้ง A และ B

sentences.ja: でも、宿題の紙がありません。
sentences.romaji: Demo, shukudai no kami ga arimasen.

translations.vi: Nhưng không thấy tờ bài tập đâu.
translations.en: But the homework sheet isn't there.
translations.tl: Pero wala ang papel ng takdang-aralin.
translations.pt: Mas a folha da lição não está.
translations.my: ဒါပေမဲ့ အိမ်စာ စာရွက် မရှိဘူး။
translations.th: แต่ไม่มีกระดาษการบ้าน

grammarNote.vi: でも = nhưng. ありません = không có.
grammarNote.en: でも = but. ありません = there isn't.

sentences.ja: 「どうしよう。机の上に、わすれてきた……。」
sentences.romaji: “Dou shiyou. Tsukue no ue ni, wasuretekita.......”

translations.vi: "Làm sao bây giờ. Mình để quên trên bàn rồi..."
translations.en: "What do I do? I left it on my desk..."
translations.tl: "Paano na? Naiwan ko sa mesa..."
translations.th: "ทำไงดี ลืมไว้บนโต๊ะ..."

grammarNote.vi: どうしよう = làm sao đây. 「〜てくる」: ~ rồi mới đến (わすれてきた = để quên ở nhà).
grammarNote.en: どうしよう = what should I do. わすれてきた = left it behind.
grammarNote.my: ဘယ်လိုလုပ်မလဲ။

sentences.ja: むねが、ドキドキしてきました。

furigana.surface: むねが、ドキドキしてきました。

translations.vi: Tim bắt đầu đập thình thịch.
translations.en: Her heart began to pound.
translations.tl: Nagsimulang kumabog ang dibdib niya.
translations.my: ရင်တွေ တဒိန်းဒိန်း ခုန်လာတယ်။
translations.th: หัวใจเริ่มเต้นตึกตัก

grammarNote.vi: ドキドキ = thình thịch. 「〜てきました」: dần dần trở nên ~.
grammarNote.en: ドキドキ = pounding. 「〜てきた」 = began to ~.
grammarNote.my: တဒိန်းဒိန်း။

sentences.ja: 「先生に、ほんとうのことを言おうよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Sensei ni, hontou no koto o iou yo.”

translations.vi: "Mình nói thật với cô giáo đi."
translations.en: "Let's tell the teacher the truth."
translations.tl: "Sabihin natin ang totoo sa guro."
translations.my: "ဆရာမကို အမှန်အတိုင်း ပြောရအောင်။"
translations.th: "บอกความจริงกับครูเถอะ"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜おう」: thể ý chí, rủ "cùng ~ nào". ほんとうのこと = sự thật.
grammarNote.en: 「〜おう」 = let's ~. ほんとうのこと = the truth.

sentences.ja: 先生が、教室に入ってきました。

translations.vi: Cô giáo bước vào lớp.
translations.en: The teacher came into the classroom.
translations.tl: Pumasok ang guro sa silid-aralan.
translations.my: ဆရာမ စာသင်ခန်းထဲ ဝင်လာတယ်။
translations.th: ครูเดินเข้าห้องเรียนมา

grammarNote.vi: 「〜てきました」: ~ vào (hướng về phía người nói).
grammarNote.en: 「〜てくる」 = come ~ing (toward the speaker).

sentences.ja: 「みなさん、おはようございます。宿題を出してください。」

furigana.surface: 「みなさん、おはようございます。

translations.vi: "Chào các em. Các em nộp bài tập nhé."
translations.en: "Good morning, everyone. Please hand in your homework."
translations.tl: "Magandang umaga, lahat. Ipasa ninyo ang takdang-aralin."
translations.my: "အားလုံး မင်္ဂလာနံနက်ပါ။ အိမ်စာ ပေးပါ။"
translations.th: "สวัสดีตอนเช้าทุกคน ส่งการบ้านด้วยนะ"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜てください」: xin hãy ~. 出す = nộp.
grammarNote.en: 「〜てください」 = please ~. 出す = hand in.

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、小さい声で言いました。
sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, chiisai koe de iimashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan nói bằng giọng nhỏ.
translations.en: Mai-chan spoke in a small voice.
translations.tl: Mahinang nagsalita si Mai-chan.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် အသံသေးသေးနဲ့ ပြောတယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังพูดด้วยเสียงเบา

grammarNote.vi: 「〜で」: bằng (phương tiện). 小さい声 = giọng nhỏ.
grammarNote.en: 「〜で」 = with/by. 小さい声 = small voice.

sentences.ja: 「先生、ごめんなさい。宿題を、家にわすれました。」
sentences.romaji: “Sensei, gomennasai. Shukudai o, ie ni wasuremashita.”

translations.vi: "Thưa cô, em xin lỗi. Em để quên bài tập ở nhà ạ."
translations.en: "I'm sorry, teacher. I left my homework at home."
translations.zh-Hans: “老师，对不起。我把作业忘在家里了。”
translations.zh-Hant: “老師，對不起。我把作業忘在家裡了。”
translations.tl: "Pasensya na po. Naiwan ko po sa bahay ang takdang-aralin."
translations.id: "Maaf, Bu Guru. PR saya ketinggalan di rumah."
translations.pt: "Desculpe, professora. Esqueci a lição em casa."
translations.my: "ဆရာမ၊ တောင်းပန်ပါတယ်။ အိမ်စာကို အိမ်မှာ မေ့ကျန်ခဲ့တယ်။"
translations.th: "ครูคะ ขอโทษค่ะ หนูลืมการบ้านไว้ที่บ้าน"

grammarNote.vi: ごめんなさい = em xin lỗi. 「〜にわすれる」: để quên ở ~.
grammarNote.en: ごめんなさい = I'm sorry. 「〜にわすれる」 = leave behind at ~.
grammarNote.my: တောင်းပန်ပါတယ်။

sentences.ja: 先生は、しずかにマイちゃんの顔を見ました。

furigana.surface: は、しずかにマイちゃんの

sentences.romaji: Sensei wa, shizuka ni Maichan no kao o mimashita.

translations.vi: Cô lặng lẽ nhìn mặt Mai-chan.
translations.en: The teacher quietly looked at Mai-chan's face.
translations.zh-Hans: 老师静静地看着小麦的脸。
translations.zh-Hant: 老師靜靜地看著小麥的臉。
translations.tl: Tahimik na tiningnan ng guro ang mukha ni Mai-chan.
translations.pt: A professora olhou em silêncio para o rosto de Mai-chan.
translations.my: ဆရာမက မိုင်ချန်ရဲ့ မျက်နှာကို တိတ်တိတ်လေး ကြည့်တယ်။
translations.th: ครูมองหน้าไมจังเงียบๆ

grammarNote.vi: しずかに = lặng lẽ. Tính từ -な + に → trạng từ.
grammarNote.en: しずかに = quietly. な-adj + に = adverb.
grammarNote.my: な + に = ကြိယာဝိသေသန။
grammarNote.th: な + に = กริยาวิเศษณ์

sentences.ja: 「ほんとうのことが言えて、えらいですね。」
sentences.romaji: “Hontou no koto ga iete, eraidesu ne.”

translations.vi: "Em dám nói thật, giỏi lắm."
translations.en: "Good for you for telling the truth."
translations.tl: "Magaling at nagsabi ka ng totoo."
translations.th: "พูดความจริงได้ เก่งมาก"

grammarNote.vi: 言える = nói được (thể khả năng). えらい = giỏi, đáng khen.
grammarNote.en: 言える = can say (potential). えらい = admirable.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 言える＝能说。えらい＝了不起。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 言える＝能說。えらい＝了不起。
grammarNote.my: えらい = တော်။

sentences.ja: 「あした、持ってきてくださいね。」

translations.vi: "Ngày mai em mang đến nhé."
translations.en: "Please bring it tomorrow."
translations.tl: "Dalhin mo bukas, ha."
translations.my: "မနက်ဖြန် ယူလာခဲ့နော်။"
translations.th: "พรุ่งนี้เอามานะ"

grammarNote.vi: 持ってくる = mang đến. 「〜ね」: nhé.
grammarNote.en: 持ってくる = bring. 「〜ね」 = okay?

sentences.ja: 「はい！ ぜったいに持ってきます！」

translations.vi: "Vâng! Nhất định em sẽ mang ạ!"
translations.en: "Yes! I'll definitely bring it!"
translations.tl: "Opo! Siguradong dadalhin ko!"
translations.my: "ဟုတ်ကဲ့! သေချာပေါက် ယူလာပါမယ်!"
translations.th: "ค่ะ! เอามาแน่นอนค่ะ!"

grammarNote.vi: ぜったいに = nhất định.
grammarNote.en: ぜったいに = definitely.

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、ほっとしました。

furigana.surface: マイちゃんは、ほっとしました。

translations.vi: Mai-chan thở phào nhẹ nhõm.
translations.en: Mai-chan felt relieved.
translations.tl: Nakahinga nang maluwag si Mai-chan.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် စိတ်သက်သာသွားတယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังโล่งใจ

grammarNote.vi: ほっとする = nhẹ nhõm.
grammarNote.en: ほっとする = feel relieved.
grammarNote.my: စိတ်သက်သာ။

sentences.ja: 夕方、家に帰ると、ビンくんが待っていました。
sentences.romaji: Yuugata, ie ni kaeru to, Binkun ga matteimashita.

translations.vi: Chiều về đến nhà, Bin đang đợi.
translations.en: When she got home in the evening, Bin was waiting.
translations.zh-Hans: 傍晚回到家，小宾在等着。
translations.zh-Hant: 傍晚回到家，小賓在等著。
translations.ko: 저녁에 집에 돌아오니 빈이 기다리고 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Pag-uwi niya sa hapon, naghihintay si Bin.
translations.ne: साँझ घर फर्कँदा बिन पर्खिरहेका थिए।
translations.id: Sore, saat pulang, Bin sudah menunggu.
translations.pt: Ao chegar em casa à tarde, Bin estava esperando.
translations.my: ညနေ အိမ်ပြန်ရောက်တော့ ဘင် စောင့်နေတယ်။
translations.th: ตอนเย็นกลับถึงบ้าน บินรออยู่

grammarNote.vi: 「〜と、〜」: khi ~ thì (thấy) ~. 待っている = đang đợi.
grammarNote.en: 「〜と」 = when ~. 待っている = be waiting.

sentences.ja: 「お姉ちゃん、これ、わすれたでしょ。」

furigana.surface: ちゃん、これ、わすれたでしょ。」

translations.vi: "Chị ơi, cái này chị quên đúng không."
translations.en: "Sis, you forgot this, didn't you?"
translations.tl: "Ate, nakalimutan mo ito, ano?"
translations.my: "မမ၊ ဒါ မေ့ခဲ့တယ် မဟုတ်လား။"
translations.th: "พี่ ลืมอันนี้ใช่ไหม"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜でしょ」: ~ đúng không (thân mật).
grammarNote.en: 「〜でしょ」 = ~, right?

sentences.ja: ビンくんの手に、あの宿題の紙がありました。
sentences.romaji: Binkun no te ni, ano shukudai no kami ga arimashita.

translations.vi: Trong tay Bin là tờ bài tập ấy.
translations.en: In Bin's hand was that very homework sheet.
translations.zh-Hans: 小宾手里拿着那张作业纸。
translations.zh-Hant: 小賓手裡拿著那張作業紙。
translations.ko: 빈의 손에 그 숙제 종이가 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Nasa kamay ni Bin ang papel na iyon.
translations.ne: बिनको हातमा त्यही गृहकार्यको कागज थियो।
translations.id: Di tangan Bin ada kertas PR itu.
translations.pt: Na mão de Bin estava aquela folha.
translations.my: ဘင်ရဲ့ လက်ထဲမှာ အဲဒီ အိမ်စာ စာရွက် ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: ในมือบินมีกระดาษการบ้านแผ่นนั้น

grammarNote.vi: あの = cái ~ ấy (đã biết).
grammarNote.en: あの = that (known) ~.

sentences.ja: でも、紙には大きなクレヨンの絵がありました。
sentences.romaji: Demo, kami ni wa ookina kureyon no e ga arimashita.

translations.vi: Nhưng trên tờ giấy có một bức vẽ bút sáp to đùng.
translations.en: But on the sheet was a big crayon drawing.
translations.zh-Hans: 可是纸上画着一大幅蜡笔画。
translations.zh-Hant: 可是紙上畫著一大幅蠟筆畫。
translations.ko: 그런데 종이에는 큰 크레용 그림이 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Pero may malaking drowing na krayola sa papel.
translations.ne: तर कागजमा ठूलो क्रेयोनको चित्र थियो।
translations.id: Tapi di kertas itu ada gambar krayon besar.
translations.pt: Mas na folha havia um enorme desenho de giz de cera.
translations.th: แต่บนกระดาษมีภาพวาดสีเทียนใหญ่ๆ

grammarNote.vi: 大きな = to (đứng trước danh từ).
grammarNote.en: 大きな = big (before nouns).

sentences.ja: 「ぼくが、かいてあげたよ。これ、お姉ちゃん！」

furigana.surface: 「ぼくが、かいてあげたよ。これ、お

translations.vi: "Em vẽ giúp chị đấy. Đây là chị nè!"
translations.en: "I drew it for you. This is you, Sis!"
translations.tl: "Iginuhit ko para sa'yo. Ikaw ito, Ate!"
translations.pt: "Eu desenhei pra você. Esta é você, mana!"
translations.th: "ผมวาดให้นะ นี่คือพี่!"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜てあげる」: làm ~ cho người khác.
grammarNote.en: 「〜てあげる」 = do ~ for someone.

sentences.ja: 「ビン！ ……でも、ちょっと上手かも。」

translations.vi: "Bin! ...Mà công nhận cũng hơi đẹp."
translations.en: "Bin! ...But it's kind of good, actually."
translations.tl: "Bin! ...Pero medyo magaling nga."
translations.th: "บิน! ...แต่ก็วาดเก่งอยู่นะ"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜かも」: có lẽ ~ (nói tắt かもしれない).
grammarNote.en: 「〜かも」 = maybe ~ (short for かもしれない).

sentences.ja: あしたは、この宿題を持っていきます。
sentences.romaji: Ashita wa, kono shukudai o motteikimasu.

translations.vi: Ngày mai, bé sẽ mang tờ bài tập này đi.
translations.en: Tomorrow, she'll take this homework with her.
translations.tl: Bukas, dadalhin niya ang takdang-aralin na ito.
translations.id: Besok ia akan membawa PR ini.
translations.pt: Amanhã ela vai levar esta lição.
translations.my: မနက်ဖြန် ဒီအိမ်စာကို ယူသွားမယ်။
translations.th: พรุ่งนี้จะเอาการบ้านนี้ไป

grammarNote.vi: 持っていく = mang đi (so với 持ってくる = mang đến).
grammarNote.en: 持っていく = take (vs. 持ってくる = bring).

sentences.ja: 先生、びっくりするかな。

translations.vi: Không biết cô giáo có giật mình không nhỉ.
translations.en: I wonder if the teacher will be surprised.
translations.tl: Magugulat kaya ang guro?
translations.id: Kira-kira Bu Guru kaget, tidak, ya.
translations.pt: Será que a professora vai se assustar?
translations.my: ဆရာမ အံ့သြမလား မသိဘူး။
translations.th: ครูจะตกใจไหมนะ

grammarNote.vi: 「〜かな」: không biết ~ nhỉ (tự hỏi). びっくりする = giật mình.
grammarNote.en: 「〜かな」 = I wonder ~. びっくりする = be surprised.
